pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 PHRASAL VERBS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are phrasal verbs formed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text
2. use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs.
4. Show that you can: identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a text and isolate the phrasal verbs formed from make, pass and look,
2. Search the internet for more examples of the given phrasal verbs and list them on different flash cards,
3. Work with peers to construct sentences on modern fashion using the given phrasal verbs,
4. Communication: It is enhanced as the learner learns to speak clearly and effectively through correct use of phrasal verbs.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are phrasal verbs formed?
2. How can one tell the meaning of a phrasal verb?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify phrasal verbs correctly in a text
2. use the phrasal verbs correctly in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
